cases.required_outcome: Current renderer behavior with a matching independently derived /2 execution binding renders and decodes successfully; activation records that derived binding.
Holding an old profile binding constant after a behavior-bearing render entrypoint change fails before successful activation.
Holding an old profile binding constant after a behavior-bearing repository-owned helper change fails before success.
Changing a behavior-bearing constant changes the derived binding; reuse of the old profile fails closed.
Comments, source location, line/debug metadata, and other frozen non-semantic noise do not change the execution binding.
Equivalent implementation loaded from a different filesystem path derives the same execution binding and activation bytes.
A runtime ABI change without an explicit frozen equivalence rule is incompatible and fails before success.
A syntactically valid caller-supplied false binding is rejected after independent derivation.
A /1 renderer profile is not accepted as a /2 execution-bound profile and cannot be reinterpreted as proof.
A truthful /2 render/decode succeeds when repository and filesystem discovery APIs are forced to fail.
Ambient installation manifests, caches, current branch, and repository HEAD do not affect a matching binding or render result.
Identical pack/profile and execution bundle repeatedly produce byte-identical activation bytes.
Instruction-like knowledge or operational-evidence remains in its structural plane while the independent identity attack fails.
A mismatching identity fails before success; with matching identity, the existing exact activation-byte-limit behavior is preserved with no truncation.
Bundle construction/execution rejects an architecture where the measured graph can diverge from the graph executed for the call.
An unenumerated mutable repository-local dependency causes bundle resolution to fail closed.
A behavior-bearing change to descriptor/binding verifier code invalidates the old profile binding.
After bundle resolution and derivation, substituting a module-global helper cannot change the executed behavior; execution remains through the captured bound reference.
A mutable closure/default dependency not deterministically represented and non-divergent is rejected during bundle construction.
An otherwise matching profile reused across a different CPython micro version without frozen equivalence fails before success.
A semantically different substitution for an allowlisted runtime primitive is detected or represented by a changed binding, so the old profile fails.
An interpreter implementation outside the frozen runtime ABI allowlist fails closed.
Filename, checkout path, first source line, line/debug tables, and frozen non-executable doc/comment noise do not alter the binding.
Truthful /2 render/decode still succeeds with repository, filesystem, installation-state, branch, network, model/search, and cache APIs forced to fail.

semantics.composite: the case contains multiple ordered assertions with the listed stable failure classes
semantics.fail_closed: the case must fail before a successful rendered activation/decoded pack is returned
semantics.success: the case must complete with the frozen success property once P9R2/P9R3 exist
